costScope: worker compute only, shared with matched Nitro fixture; build/setup/storage excluded; cold official3GB circuitfetch included; warm proof not measured
CPUCounterScope: sum of owned-process /proc/stat user+system counters at final0.5s sample, includes setup+native+guest+proof+verification; final exact getrusage not recorded, not an exact final proof-onlyCPU total
peakRSSScope: 0.5s samples, summed process RSS upper bound including shared pages; not exact /procVmHWM
wholePodPeakScope: includes reclaimable filecache, builds and parallelNitro
